title: PromotionState
description: The complete, granular rule-promotion lifecycle used by the Knowledge Graph's promotion-gate model (PROGRAM-003 Owner Decision 3, 2026-07-25). No state is collapsed. Every transition beyond DISCOVERED requires a traceable OwnerDecision record (see owner-decision.schema.json) documenting the evidence, validation, or authorization appropriate to that specific stage -- no promotion happens automatically. This is a shared, versioned enum definition: a future revision to strategy-rule.schema.json may $ref this file's enum for a promotionState field once a real StrategyRule reaches DISCOVERED, rather than redeclaring the list inline.
$comment: Required linear order: DISCOVERED < ASSERTION_SUPPORTED < RESEARCH_REVIEWED < MODELED < IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVED < CODED < IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFIED < REPLAY_ELIGIBLE < REPLAY_VALIDATED < SHADOW_ELIGIBLE < SHADOW_VALIDATED < PAPER_ELIGIBLE < PAPER_APPROVED < PAPER_VALIDATED < PRODUCTION_REVIEW < PRODUCTION_APPROVED < LIVE_REVIEW < LIVE_APPROVED. A rule's recorded state must never exceed the highest stage its OwnerDecision history actually authorizes; the integrity validator checks this directly (see PROMOTION_WITHOUT_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION in graph-integrity-report.schema.json).
